unique_text.suffix_text: damage-taken multiplier to that enemy for 7s even if the enemy is immune to the shockwave movement/effect.

unique_text.prefix_text: Spawn
unique_text.suffix_text: number of Electrons. On Electron hit, deal 15% of current remaining HP, multiplied by 0.25 against Bosses and Fleets.

unique_text.prefix_text: Compute tower damage multiplier from current cash digit count / logarithmic form; clamp final multiplier to at least x1.00.

unique_text.suffix_text: seconds.

unique_text.suffix_text: stack count.

unique_text.prefix_text: Retarget Spotlight to the boss and cause reflected light around that boss to increase nearby enemies damage taken by
unique_text.suffix_text: multiplier.
